column2: Old and advanced in days, repeated wrapping and failure to become warm preserve the opening condition; no diagnosis is added.
The attendants propose a young virgin, attending, warming and lying with the king, followed by his becoming warm. Ordinary royal address remains.
The search covers all Israel's territory and brings the selected Abishag the Shunammite to the king; no additional search criteria are supplied.
Very fair, warming and serving remain distinct from the negative knowing euphemism; the narrator does not state sexual intercourse.
Adonijah's self-exaltation, I will reign, chariots, horsemen and fifty runners retain his own initiative and the exact count.
The father's never restraining him, the why question, handsome appearance and birth after Absalom remain.
column3: His mother supplies the unexpressed female subject of bore; it does not assert that Adonijah and Absalom shared a mother.

column2: Words with Joab and Abiathar are rendered conferred, followed by their support behind Adonijah; no formal coronation is inferred.
The full six-part opposition list retains Shimei and Rei and the repeated following language with its negation.
Sheep, calves and lambs, Zoheleth by Rogel, all brothers and prominent Judah men remain; king's sons is not substituted for the selected brothers.
The four excluded parties remain explicitly uninvited, with Solomon identified as Adonijah's brother.
Nathan's negative question and the contrast between Adonijah's accession and David's ignorance remain reported speech to Solomon's mother.
Come, counsel and the imperative rescue preserve Nathan's instruction and both threatened lives.
The rehearsed royal oath keeps Solomon's future reign and throne, followed by the question about Adonijah; nested human address remains you.
Behold, still speaking, Nathan coming afterward and completing her words preserve the planned sequence without replacing complete with an asserted independent confirmation.
Bathsheba enters the chamber while the very old king is served by Abishag; no departure of another character is inserted.
Bowing and prostration remain human court gestures; What is your concern gives the idiomatic sense of What is to you.
Bathsheba repeats the oath by the Lord your God and the two succession clauses without changing ordinary address to David.
Now behold and the king's lack of knowledge retain the presentative emphasis and direct accusation of ignorance, not complicity.
The reported abundant sacrifices and invitations retain Joab's office and Solomon's exclusion as your servant.
All Israel's eyes toward David and his task of announcing the successor preserve the second-to-third-person courtly address shift.
Sleeping with the fathers and the future sinners remain in Bathsheba's warning.
column3: The political or culpability sense of sinners is unresolved; outlaws, condemned or executed is not silently substituted.

column2: Propose Behold before the still-speaking clause to retain the selected presentative as Nathan arrives; no intervening delay is added.
The announcement Behold Nathan and his face-to-ground prostration retain the repeated presence-before-the-king language.
Nathan's selected statement you said and the quoted succession terms remain, with no added interrogative particle.
column3: Whether to punctuate this as an incredulous question remains an editorial question; the retained statement follows the selected running-text punctuation.

column2: For introduces the evidence: today's abundant sacrifice, full invitation list and behold eating and drinking before Adonijah with the royal acclamation.
The emphatic me, your servant and all three additional exclusions remain, distinguishing this list from verse 10.
The whether-question concerns royal authorization and failure to inform the servant; the throne's future occupant remains unnamed in the question.
David's summons and Bathsheba's entrance and standing remain without inserting an explanation of her earlier location.
The living-Lord oath and redemption of David's life from every affliction remain in third-person divine reference.
The prior oath, after me, my throne and in my place culminate in this very day; the repeated assurance is not reduced to a bare promise.
Face-to-earth prostration and the wish that King David live for ever preserve courtly speech rather than an assertion of bodily immortality.
Zadok, Nathan and Benaiah are summoned and enter together; their named offices and Benaiah's parentage remain.
Plural instructions take the servants, mount Solomon on David's own mule and bring him to Gihon retain all three actions.
Both Zadok and Nathan are named in the anointing command, followed by horn sounding and the specified acclamation.
Throne, reign in David's place and commanded leadership over both Israel and Judah remain; no procession clause is imported.
Benaiah's assent and wish that the Lord confirm it remain distinct from a narrated divine confirmation.
The analogy with God's presence with David and the wish for Solomon's greater throne preserve third-person divine He and ordinary royal address.
All five parties descend, seat Solomon on David's mule and lead him to Gihon; the guard groups remain separately named.
Zadok takes the oil horn from the tent, anoints and sounds the horn; the whole people acclaim Solomon.
column3: The narrative singular agency is retained alongside the two-person command and later two-person report; no harmonizing agent is added.

column2: Following, dancing in choruses, great rejoicing and the earth bursting at their sound preserve the selected exuberant imagery, without importing flute playing.
Adonijah and guests hear while finishing food; Joab hears the horn and asks about the resounding city. No additional alarm is narrated here.
Propose behold in the still-speaking arrival of Jonathan. The invitation, man of ability and imperative bring good news remain rather than making good news a narrator's guarantee.
Indeed retains kai mala's strong affirmation that David made Solomon king; an unsupported initial No is not introduced.
The report repeats the five dispatched parties and seating on the king's mule, preserving this repetition rather than abbreviating the earlier narrative.
The report names both Zadok and Nathan as anointers, locates it at Gihon and explains the heard city noise by the rejoicing return.
Solomon's sitting on the royal throne is stated as accomplished within Jonathan's report.
The servants' blessing asks God to improve Solomon's name and enlarge his throne beyond David's; David's prostration on the bed remains separate.
The king's blessing explicitly includes one from my offspring and his own seeing eyes, preserving the selected fuller succession statement.
Astonishment, rising and each guest going his own way retain the collapse of Adonijah's gathering without adding a pursuit.
Fear of Solomon, rising, departure and grasping the altar horns remain consecutive acts; no legal guarantee of sanctuary is inserted.
The reported fear, grip on the horns, this-day oath and sword death remain; the inherited whether he will not keeps the selected negative construction visible.
column3: The force of ei ou after swear remains unresolved. This provisional retention does not settle whether an assurance not to kill or an oath-form polarity requires different English.

column2: The two conditions distinguish becoming a man of ability from discovered wickedness; the no-hair-falling oath idiom and death consequence remain.
column3: Son of ability is idiomatically man of ability; the negative assurance realizes the elliptical ei oath rather than an ordinary open if-clause.

column2: Solomon sends and has Adonijah brought down, receives his prostration and dismisses him home. Come now, go renders deuro with the directional phrase idiomatically.
